note: durée d'utilité des équipements des usines DRAM portée de cinq à sept ans au quatrième trimestre de l'exercice 2016, changement d'estimation prospectif
quote: In the fourth quarter of 2016, we revised the estimated useful lives of equipment in our DRAM wafer fabrication facilities from five to seven years as a result of the lengthening period of time between DRAM product technology node transitions, an increased re-use rate of equipment, and industry trends
